claycode.delta: Add a canonical-IR/runtime candidate for typed atomic cells and compare-exchange that separates semantic op identity from physical retries. Version/epoch-bound identity is required by default for semantic Clay state where equality is not identity. No surface syntax change is justified yet.

harness.delta: H2/H3 differential replay should include ABA schedules, weak-CAS retry perturbation and semantic-vs-execution hash checks. Harness should compare successful atomic semantic outcomes independently of physical retry counts while retaining full attempt traces.

frank.delta: Frank state transitions that rely on compare-and-set style guards should bind state epoch/version identity where values may recur. This is a research constraint on the target system, not authority for Frank to modify its own Harness.

clayresearch.delta: Loop-of-loops and Safe-Effect work should distinguish atomicity from freshness/identity: an operation can be atomic yet semantically stale under ABA.

gwt.delta: Workspace/re-entry experiments that share mutable state should log semantic atomic outcome and state epoch separately from contention retries so scheduler contention is not misread as cognitive causal effect.

emergenz.delta: Lesion/rescue and causal-emergence experiments should treat stale ABA accepts and retry contention as execution confounds unless intentionally manipulated. No emergence claim follows from atomics.

hyperposition.delta: Dynamic topology/candidate relations that can return to the same visible value require versioned semantic identity if CAS-like transitions are used; value recurrence must not collapse temporal distinction.

claygraph.delta: Graph-node/relation mutation paths using optimistic compare-exchange should test node/relation epoch or equivalent stable identity, not value equality alone, to reject A->B->A stale updates.

unifieddb.delta: UnifiedDB semantic epoch/version is a natural candidate identity component for optimistic CAS-style state publication. A stale expected epoch must fail even when the visible value has returned to the same representation.

global_laws: value_equality != semantic_identity unless the type/resource contract proves it
memory_ordering must be explicit in canonical semantics or safely fixed by the portable profile; never silently inherited from a host
next_discriminator: Production ClayCode IR/typechecker/lowering implementation plus Ubuntu-target ABA/order/retry differential.
